[**02_engineering_statics/CURATED_ESSENTIALS.md**](./02_engineering_statics/CURATED_ESSENTIALS.md): 2D/3D particle equilibrium, moments & couples, truss analysis (Joints & Sections), centroids, distributed loads, beam SFD/BMD differential calculus, friction (belts/wedges/screws), and moments of inertia.
3. [**03_mechanics_of_materials/CURATED_ESSENTIALS.md**](./03_mechanics_of_materials/CURATED_ESSENTIALS.md): Stress/strain tensors, Hooke's law, Mohr's circle, flexure and transverse shear in beams, shaft torsion, thin-walled pressure vessels, Euler column buckling, and fracture/fatigue mechanics.
